   Original table: fitting/python/data/ltc_table_sheen_volume.cpp

   SIGGRAPH 2022.
   License: Apache License 2.0 (see Apache-2.0-LICENSE.txt).
   Modified for Secret v0.4: coefficients are stored as signed 16-bit normalized
   values and bilinearly decoded at runtime.
